newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish tycoon's stolen body found in nearby grave.
newsitem.headline: Turkish tycoon's stolen body found in nearby grave.

text.p: The body of Turkish industrialist Vehbi Koc, who died last February aged 95, is believed to have been found near the grave from which it was stolen last autumn, Anatolian news agency said on Wednesday.

Istanbul governor Ridvan Yenisen told the agency that authorities were 99 percent certain they were the remains of Vehbi Koc. The body was found in an empty grave in a plastic bag 300 metres from Koc's grave in Zincirlikuyu cemetery.
His body was stolen from its grave on October 24.
Yenisen said four people had been detained in connection with the find and another person was being sought.

Koc started his business life in 1917 running a grocery store and built an industrial empire with a turnover of $8.2 billion and 32,700 employees by the time he died. The Koc Holding company is now run by his son Rahmi.
